title: Construction Contracts
summary: Historical standard governing construction contract revenue via the percentage-of-completion method, converged with IAS 11 and now withdrawn and superseded by Ind AS 115.

bannerNotice.title: Withdrawn Standard – Superseded by Ind AS 115
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 11 was withdrawn effective the same transition date as IAS 11's global withdrawal, replaced by Ind AS 115's five-step revenue recognition model. This page is retained for HISTORICAL reference and to help practitioners understand the transition impact on construction/EPC-sector companies. Section 11 covers the full comparison with its IFRS counterpart.
